propositions: When the completion verifier fails with insufficiency-only (all unmet criteria lack refutation evidence), the gate should auto-resume the full verification re-run instead of surfacing failure to the operator
Auto-resume should be bounded by verify.auto_resume_max (default 2) and a strict progress condition—dispatch only when the prior attempt increased cache-credited PASS count; zero progress stops early
The resumption loop must live at the shared close-gate seam (close_precheck._completion_precheck's verify_completion call) so CLI, MCP, and library closes all trigger auto-resume identically
Qualification for auto-resume must reuse the existing completion_reconcile._insufficiency_only predicate unchanged, with no schema, prompt, or model-facing changes
Per-attempt resumption state (attempt number, cache-credited PASS count, remaining unmet count) must be recorded and visible in the verdict trail and close output
